map.出国旅行必备应急短语，点击喇叭可朗读（需浏览器支持）: Essential emergency phrases for travel abroad; tap the speaker to hear them read aloud (browser support required)
map.应急短语按场景分类：求助（报警、失窃、迷路）、医疗（过敏、发烧、受伤）、交通（改: Emergency phrases are grouped by scenario: help (police, theft, lost), medical (allergy, fever, injury), transport (rebooking, lost documents) and so on. Each group lists the local-language phrase beside the Mandarin equivalent with pronunciation notes, and roughly 10 to 20 common expressions cover most emergencies. Emergency numbers differ by country (China 110/120/119, EU 112, US 911) and can be tapped to hear them read aloud.
